navigationReview.notes: 70-page evaluation summarizes 237 items: A213, B21, C3, D0. Detailed sheets show project budget execution in yen, actions, A–D implementation ratings and next-year direction. Examples include overseas friendship ambassador expenditure 1,104,484 yen with one Peruvian trainee accepted, and community grants 2,440,296 yen with noticeboards and public-address equipment installed. 237 comprehensive-plan implementation items; detailed project costs, outcomes and ratings within plan evaluation, not verified general administrative-business evaluation system. 確認範囲：Supported Web extracted text sampled; not a complete locally archived full-text review.
navigationReview.yearNotes: 2025。FY2025 evaluation label; some detailed indicators cite FY2024. Exact expenditure target years not fully reconciled.
